idea-plugin.name: UUID, ULID & NanoID Toolkit
idea-plugin.description:
UUID, ULID & NanoID Toolkit

Generate and inspect the identifiers you actually use in tests and APIs — no browser, no external tool, fully offline.

  • Generate: UUID v1 (time-based), v4 (random), v6 and v7 (time-ordered), name-based v5 (SHA-1) and v3 (MD5) from a namespace + name, ULID, TypeID (a type prefix + a UUID v7 in Crockford base32), and NanoID — appended to a list you can select and copy.
  • Inspect: paste any value and see what it is — the UUID version and variant, the embedded timestamp for v1/v6/v7 and ULID (decoded to a readable instant), the node and clock sequence of v1/v6, a Snowflake ID against the Twitter and Discord epochs, and the prefix + decoded UUID of a TypeID.

Open it from View ▸ Tool Windows ▸ ID Toolkit.

More from the Kassi QA & fintech toolkit:

Spec-valid test data: Kassi Test Data · Go Test Data · pytest Fixtures · HTTP Data Injector · SQL Synthetic Seeder

Fintech & validators: Checksum & Regex Playground · ACH / NACHA Toolkit · ISO 8583 Inspector · SWIFT MT & ISO 20022 Validator · Crypto Codec Toolkit

QA & testing: Flaky Test Linter · Compose Testability Linter · MRZ & Barcode Inspector · Secret & Card Leak Guard · PII Anonymizer / Repro Sanitizer · Robot Framework Pro · dbt Navigator

Source, issues & docs: github.com/VadimToptunov/kassi-plugins
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.10.0

  • Asks once for a Marketplace review after you have used the plugin for a while — a plain, dismissable notification with "Don't ask again". Nothing else changes.

1.9.0

  • New generator: UUID v8 (RFC 9562 §5.8) — the custom/vendor variant with the fixed version (8) and variant (10xx) bits and a random 122-bit payload. The inspector already identifies it.

1.8.1

  • Compatibility: the format picker no longer uses a list-cell-renderer factory scheduled for removal on the 2026.x IDE platform. No behavior change.

1.8.0

  • Bulk generate + formats: set a Count to emit many identifiers per click, choose a UUID output format (UPPERCASE, {braces}, urn:uuid:, or no-hyphens), and Copy all to the clipboard in one click.

1.7.0

  • Generate UUID v1 (time-based). Inspect now decodes the node and clock sequence of v1/v6 UUIDs, and reads a Snowflake ID against both the Twitter and Discord epochs.

1.6.0

  • The tool window now shows a distinct stripe icon.

1.5.0

  • Generate and inspect TypeID (jetify): a type prefix + a UUID v7 encoded in lowercase Crockford base32; inspection shows the prefix and the decoded UUID.

1.4.0

  • Inspect Snowflake IDs: decode timestamp, worker and sequence.

1.3.0

  • Inspect KSUID: decode its embedded creation timestamp.

1.2.0

  • Generate and inspect UUID v6 (RFC 9562), with its embedded timestamp.

1.1.1

  • Added the plugin icon.

1.1.0

  • Name-based UUIDs: deterministic v5 (SHA-1) and v3 (MD5) from a namespace (DNS/URL/OID/X500) + a name.

1.0.0

  • Initial release: generate UUID v4/v7, ULID and NanoID, and inspect any of them (version, variant, embedded timestamp) — offline.
